repository.omitted: Prior results/ directories; no omitted file is required to import or test this package.

openai_math.scope: README and manuscript catalogue applicability audit; no mathematical theorem imported.

prior_work.integration_scope: Patch targets pinned fast subtree; it is not a combined merge of prior continuation backends.

source_transport.measured_baseline: Each measured materialized baseline file equals its canonical Git blob followed by one LF byte (0a).
source_transport.delivered_baseline: That one byte was removed, and all 40 Git blob SHA1 identities were verified.
source_transport.integrated_code: Existing files were normalized at EOF. Each recorded scanner algorithm hash matches either the delivered file or that file plus one LF. New dense_compose.py exactly matches its measured hash.
source_transport.fixtures: Exact measured byte streams are preserved in verification/finite_quotient/fixtures; normalized complete scanner PDs are also retained in the scanner JSON.
source_transport.timing_effect: Imports and JSON parsing are outside the timed intervals. No timed algorithm or mathematical input was changed by final-LF normalization.

environment.limitation: Shared-container wall-clock measurements; no statistical significance or universal speedup claim.

validation.formal_proof_status: Written mathematical arguments and independent computational checks; no Lean formalization or external peer review.
